[[Godrej Capital]] | website = {{URL|https://www.godrejindustries.com}} }} '''Godrej Industries Group''' is an Indian conglomerate headquartered in [[Mumbai]], with business interests across consumer goods, chemicals, real estate, agriculture, financial services, and investments. The group traces its origins to the Godrej business founded in 1897 by Ardeshir Godrej, which later developed into the diversified Godrej Group.{{Cite web |last=team |first=dcf model |title=Godrej Industries Limited: history, ownership, mission, how it works & makes money |url=https://dcf-model.com/blogs/history/godrejindns-history-mission-ownership |access-date=2026-04-01 |website=AI-Powered Discounted Cash Flow Model Templates |language=en}} Godrej Industries Group comprises a portfolio of operating and investment companies, including Godrej Consumer Products, Godrej Properties, Godrej Agrovet, Godrej Industries (Chemicals), Godrej Fund Management, and Godrej Capital. Its businesses operate across Asia, Africa, and Latin America and serve over 1 billion consumers globally. In 2024, the Godrej Group underwent a restructuring following a family settlement agreement between members of the Godrej family, resulting in the separation of business interests into two independent entities: Godrej Industries Group and Godrej Enterprises Group.{{Cite web |last=team |first=dcf model |title=Godrej Industries Limited: history, ownership, mission, how it works & makes money |url=https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/godrej-group-division-here-s-a-look-at-127-year-old-history-of-the-company-124050100439_1.html |access-date=2026-04-01 |website=AI-Powered Discounted Cash Flow Model Templates |language=en}} == History == The Godrej business was founded in 1897 by Ardeshir Godrej in Mumbai. The initial venture involved the manufacture of locks.{{Cite web |title=Godrej Group division: Here's a look at 127-year-old history of the company |url=https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/godrej-group-division-here-s-a-look-at-127-year-old-history-of-the-company-124050100439_1.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260128120505/https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/godrej-group-division-here-s-a-look-at-127-year-old-history-of-the-company-124050100439_1.html |archive-date=2026-01-28 |access-date=2026-04-18 |website=www.business-standard.com |language=en-US|url-status=live}} In the early years of the business, the company developed indigenous manufacturing capabilities and introduced security products, safes, at a time when such products were largely imported into India.{{Cite web |title=7 |url=https://www.news18.com/explainers/why-127-year-old-godrej-group-announced-split-who-gets-what-what-it-means-for-investors-brand-8874887.html |website=News 18}} In 1919, Ardeshir Godrej launched the world's first pure-vegetarian soap, made from vegetable oil extracts.{{Cite web |last=Traveller |first=Condé Nast |date=2020-06-28 |title=The original Made in India success story: a soap so good, even Tagore modelled for it |url=https://www.cntraveller.in/story/made-india-brand-success-story-soap-good-even-tagore-ad-godrej-swadeshi/ |access-date=2026-04-18 |website=Condé Nast Traveller India |language=en-IN}} In the early decades of the 20th century, the business expanded into additional product categories. In 1951, the company was commissioned to manufacture ballot boxes for India’s first general election.{{Cite web |title=Swadeshi to ahimsa, locks to rockets: How Godrej won the nation's trust |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/company/corporate-trends/swadeshi-to-ahimsa-locks-to-rockets-how-godrej-won-the-nations-trust/articleshow/109750352.cms?from=mdr |website=Economic Times}} The group diversified into new sectors in the later decades. In 1990, Godrej Properties was established to expand into real estate, followed by the incorporation of Godrej Agrovet in 1991 for agribusiness operations.{{Cite web |title=Rising Giants: Spotlighting Godrej Agrovet |url=https://marcellus.in/newsletter/rising-giant/rising-giants-spotlighting-godrej-agrovet/ |access-date=2026-04-18 |website=Marcellus |language=en-US}} == Businesses == Godrej Industries Group operates through a portfolio of businesses across sectors including agribusiness, real estate, chemicals, financial services, and investments.{{Cite web |date=2021-11-30 |title=The planned split in the Godrej Group: What to expect - PrimeInvestor |url=https://primeinvestor.in/reports/the-planned-split-in-the-godrej-group/ |access-date=2026-04-18 |language=en-US}}{{Cite web |last=Chettiar |first=Archana |date=2024-05-06 |title=Godrej Industries Split: 6 Things To Know As An Investor - Best Stock Market Blogs & Investment Insights {{!}} Equentis |url=https://www.equentis.com/blog/godrej-industries-split-6-things-to-know-as-an-investor/ |access-date=2026-04-18 |language=en-US}} Godrej Agrovet Limited operates in the animal feed and agribusiness sectors.{{Citation |title=Godrej Agrovet |date=2026-01-03 |work=Wikipedia |url=https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Godrej_Agrovet&oldid=1330874822 |access-date=2026-04-18 |language=en}} Its subsidiary Astec Lifesciences operates in agrochemicals, and its joint venture, Godrej Tyson Foods, is engaged in processed poultry products. Godrej Properties Limited is engaged in real estate development, with residential and commercial projects across multiple Indian cities.{{Citation |title=Godrej Properties |date=2026-01-26 |work=Wikipedia |url=https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Godrej_Properties&oldid=1334991024 |access-date=2026-04-18 |language=en}} Godrej Chemicals manufactures oleochemicals and related products used in industries including personal care, pharmaceuticals, and food. Godrej Capital Limited operates in the financial services sector, offering lending products including housing and personal loans. The group’s present lending operations, housed under Godrej Capital Limited, encompass Godrej Housing Finance Limited as well as Godrej Finance Limited, which is a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC).{{Cite web |last=Service |first=Statesman News |date=2026-01-14 |title=Godrej incorporates subsidiary to enhance its presence in financial services |url=https://www.thestatesman.com/business/godrej-incorporates-subsidiary-to-enhance-its-presence-in-financial-services-1503540574.html |access-date=2026-04-18 |website=The Statesman |language=en}} Godrej Consumer Products Limited (GCPL) is an Indian Multinational consumer goods company based in Mumbai, India. GCPL's products include soap, hair colourants, toiletries and liquid detergents. Its brands include 'Cinthol', 'Godrej Fair Glow', 'Godrej No.1' and 'Godrej Shikakai' in soaps, 'Godrej Powder Hair Dye', 'Renew', 'ColourSoft' in hair colourants and 'Ezee' liquid detergent.{{Citation |title=Godrej Consumer Products |date=2025-09-21 |work=Wikipedia |url=https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Godrej_Consumer_Products&oldid=1312531074 |access-date=2026-04-18 |language=en}}{{Circular reference|date=June 2026}} Godrej Ventures is the group’s real estate-focused investment platform, managing investments across real estate assets. == Corporate structure == Godrej Industries Ltd., Godrej Properties Ltd., Godrej Agrovet Ltd., Godrej Consumer Products Ltd., and Godrej Capital Limited operate under the Godrej Industries Group.{{Cite web |last=Sharma |first=Dipti |date=2024-05-02 |title=Godrej split: What it means for the group's listed companies {{!}} Stock Market News |url=https://www.livemint.com/market/stock-market-news/godrej-split-what-it-means-for-the-groups-listed-companies-11714572130234.html |access-date=2026-04-19 |website=mint |language=en}} The group is chaired by Nadir Godrej and is controlled by Adi Godrej, and their immediate families.{{Cite news |last=Mishra |first=Lalatendu |date=2024-05-01 |title=Godrej family announces ownership realignment, group splits into two |url=https://www.thehindu.com/business/Industry/godrej-family-announces-ownership-realignment-group-splits-into-two/article68126670.ece |access-date=2026-04-19 |work=The Hindu |language=en-IN |issn=0971-751X}} Pirojsha Godrej serves as Executive Vice Chairperson of Godrej Industries Group and is expected to succeed Nadir Godrej as Chairperson. The listed companies within the group operate as separate legal entities, with their own management and operational structures. The company announced plans to transfer its entire stake in Godrej Capital Limited to a wholly owned subsidiary, Godrej FS Limited, subject to shareholder approval, following its quarterly financial results. == Corporate social responsibility   == Godrej Industries Group undertakes its sustainability and social responsibility initiatives through programmes focused on environmental sustainability, resource efficiency, and community development.{{Cite web |title=Godrej Industries' Journey Towards Sustainable Excellence |url=https://www.businessworld.in/article/godrej-industries-journey-towards-sustainable-excellence-489721 |access-date=2026-04-20 |website=BW Businessworld |language=en|last=Mohan|first=Awantika|date=1 September 2023}}{{Cite web |title=Godrej Industries Group, BMC, Bhamla Foundation Launch Awareness Campaign Against Plastic Pollution |url=https://thecsruniverse.com/articles/godrej-industries-group-bmc-bhamla-foundation-launch-awareness-campaign-against-plastic-pollution |access-date=2026-04-20 |website=The CSR Universe |language=en}} In 2011, Godrej Industries Group formalised its sustainability framework under the “Good & Green” initiative, which established targets related to emissions reduction, waste management, water conservation, and energy efficiency, along with social objectives including employment generation and public health interventions. The programme was subsequently expanded to include value chain initiatives involving suppliers, logistics, and consumers, with a focus on promoting sustainable practices beyond the organisation’s operations. It has committed to reducing absolute emissions in line with science-based targets and has set internal net-zero targets for 2035. It is also a signatory to global climate initiatives and has undertaken measures related to carbon reduction and resource efficiency. Godrej Industries Group has implemented water conservation programmes in multiple Indian states and reports returning more water to the environment than it withdraws. In 2025, Godrej Industries Group, in collaboration with the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation, the Bhamla Foundation, and the United Nations Environment Programme, launched the #BeatPlasticPollution campaign to address plastic waste and promote sustainable consumption practices. Godrej Consumer Products Limited joined hands with the Home Insect Control Association for an initiative that promotes the safe disposal of plastic waste.{{Cite web |title=GCPL and HICA join hands for an initiative to promote plastic waste disposal of household insecticide products |url=https://www.aninews.in/news/business/gcpl-and-hica-join-hands-for-an-initiative-to-promote-plastic-waste-disposal-of-household-insecticide-products20200203141957/ |access-date=2026-04-20 |website=ANI News |language=en}} == Corporate governance   == The financial results are reviewed by the Audit Committee prior to approval by the Board.{{Cite web |title=Rising Giants: Spotlighting Godrej Agrovet |url=https://marcellus.in/newsletter/rising-giant/rising-giants-spotlighting-godrej-agrovet/ |access-date=2026-04-20 |website=Marcellus |language=en-US}} The company makes disclosures to stock exchanges, including BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited, in compliance with the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. Regulatory filings are authorised by the Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. == Leadership == Adi Godrej is the Chairman Emeritus of the Godrej Industries Group.{{Cite web |title=ADI GODREJ {{!}} Latest News, Updates & Articles on ADI GODREJ |url=https://www.outlookbusiness.com/topic/adi-godrej |access-date=2026-04-21 |website=Outlook Business |language=en}} Nadir Godrej serves as Chairman and Managing Director of Godrej Industries Group.{{Cite web |date=2026-02-23 |title=Godrej Industries, the holding company of the Godrej Industries Group, has proposed an extension for its incumbent Chairman and Managing Director Nadir Godrej, ahead of a planned leadership transition later this year. |url=https://www.outlookbusiness.com/corporate/godrej-industries-seeks-extension-for-chairman-nadir-godrej-ahead-of-planned-leadership-handover |access-date=2026-04-21 |website=Outlook Business |language=en}} Pirojsha Godrej serves as Executive Vice Chairperson of Godrej Industries Group, Executive Chairperson of Godrej Properties Limited, and Chairman Designate until Nadir Godrej retires when he turns 75. Godrej Industries Group is an Indian conglomerate headquartered in Mumbai, with business interests across consumer goods, chemicals, real estate, agriculture, financial services, and investments.
The group traces its origins to the Godrej business founded in 1897 by Ardeshir Godrej, which later developed into the diversified Godrej Group.
Godrej Industries Group comprises a portfolio of operating and investment companies, including Godrej Consumer Products, Godrej Properties, Godrej Agrovet, Godrej Industries (Chemicals), Godrej Fund Management, and Godrej Capital. Its businesses operate across Asia, Africa, and Latin America and serve over 1 billion consumers globally.
In 2024, the Godrej Group underwent a restructuring following a family settlement agreement between members of the Godrej family, resulting in the separation of business interests into two independent entities: Godrej Industries Group and Godrej Enterprises Group.
